Commun., DOI: 10.3389/fcomm.2022.1048896), 823 total participants were analyzed in a 2 (vowel: within) × 2 (product category: between) mixed ANOVA, and the simple vowel effect for convertible and knife is printed with the full-model residual degrees of freedom (F1,821 = 4.717, p = 0.030), corresponding to N = 823 contributing to a pooled error term, whereas the mutually exclusive convertible (n = 208) and knife (n = 210) conditions contain n = 418 subgroup participants and the printed η2p = 0.011 (and Table 5 r = 0.106, 95% CI [0.010, 0.200]) reflects df = 417 rather than 821. Because the primary text does not positively specify whether the test is a pooled-error contrast within the 823-participant ANOVA or a separate 418-participant subgroup model and internally conflicts between F1,821 and η2p = 0.011, the analytic sample size role cannot be uniquely resolved without repairing the source.
